design_vision.archetype: Archetype 7: Electric & Neon (Adapted for Aceternity UI/Linear Premium Minimalism)
design_vision.core_concept: Recruiters must understand Kedar's Growth Marketing strategy in <10s. The site should feel like a premium SaaS product, not a static document. Heavy focus on storytelling, proof, and high-end motion.

surface.description: Premium slate blue for cards and floating headers. Always use with backdrop-blur-xl.

accent.description: Used strictly for interactive states, metric highlights, and subtle background glows. DO NOT use for heavy solid backgrounds.

surface_styles.flat_card: bg-[#0F172A] border border-white/5 hover:border-white/20 transition-colors duration-300
surface_styles.tracing_beam_card: relative overflow-hidden border border-white/10 before:absolute before:inset-0 before:bg-[radial-gradient(circle_at_var(--mouse-x)_var(--mouse-y),rgba(124,58,237,0.15),transparent_80%)]

hero.headline: Word-by-word staggered reveal using framer-motion.
hero.background: Subtle, mouse-responsive CSS radial gradient glow + fixed SVG grid pattern with linear-gradient mask for depth.

buttons.primary: Magnetic hover effect using framer-motion. bg-[#F8FAFC] text-[#050816] hover:bg-[#E2E8F0] font-medium transition-all px-6 py-3 rounded-full
buttons.secondary: Glass pill button. bg-white/5 border border-white/10 hover:bg-white/10 text-[#F8FAFC] backdrop-blur-md transition-all px-6 py-3 rounded-full

scroll.lenis: Implement smooth scrolling globally using @studio-freight/lenis to give it a premium feel.

hover_states.cards: Smooth -translate-y-1 transform, slight increase in border opacity (border-white/20), and ambient drop shadow (shadow-2xl shadow-[#7C3AED]/10).

navigation.style: Floating glassmorphism pill, fixed top-6 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 z-50 px-6 py-3 rounded-full border border-white/10 bg-[#0F172A]/70 backdrop-blur-xl flex gap-8 items-center

hero.layout: grid md:grid-cols-2 gap-12 min-h-screen items-center pt-24
hero.left: Headline ('Growth Marketing Strategist'), Subhead, Metrics row (4+ Years, 20+ Brands, 47% Email Growth), CTAs.
hero.right: Animated Growth Dashboard: Absolute positioned overlapping glass panels. Include abstract growth graph (Recharts), funnel viz, and AI workflow nodes connecting via SVG paths. Use Framer Motion for floating effect.

case_studies.layout: Grid cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-6. Max 3 items. Use Bento Grid spacing.
case_studies.interaction: Hover expands image/glow. Click opens Radix UI / Shadcn Dialog modal with sections: Problem / Strategy / Actions / Results / Tools.
case_studies.visual: Card background uses media_assets below with overlay.

growth_framework.layout: Horizontal or zigzag flowing timeline (Research -> Strategy -> Content -> Distribution -> Optimization).
growth_framework.interaction: Each node expands on hover to show detailed bullet points. Use lucide-react icons. Animated dashed SVG lines connect the nodes, with a 'flowing dot' animation to show direction.

experience.layout: Vertical timeline with a glowing left border. Aceternity 'Tracing Beam' style effect on the line.
experience.visual: High contrast role titles, subdued dates. Collapsible sections for older roles to save space. Clear spacing.

skills.layout: Bento Grid clusters (Growth & Performance, Content & Social, Analytics, AI Workflows).
skills.interaction: Hover reveals specific tools/examples inside the cluster via cross-fade.

currently_exploring.visual: Aceternity style 'Hover Effect' cards. When mouse moves over the grid, a radial gradient follows the cursor underneath the cards.

contact.layout: Minimalist centered block with generous top/bottom padding.
contact.content: Massive 'Let's Connect' heading. Links: Email (mailto), LinkedIn, Resume Download. DO NOT include GitHub.

growth_systems.description: Abstract data dashboard for Growth Systems case study background.

multi_industry_agency.description: Modern dark architecture for Agency case study background.

d2c_wellness.description: Abstract digital nodes for D2C Wellness AI/growth case study.

technical_requirements.language: JavaScript (.jsx/.js files ONLY. Do NOT use TypeScript/.tsx)

testing.rules: All interactive elements, forms, and major sections MUST include 'data-testid' attributes.
